headline: Design and creative industries are polarised: Finnish games are restructuring (RedLynx closure proposed, Metacore cuts) while grants and bio-based textile work (Spinnova) keep advancing under EU circularity policy.
outlook_reason: Games funding and jobs are weak and capital is concentrated in AI and dev tools, but EU creative-economy, New European Bauhaus and textile circularity programmes give research-based ventures real grant routes.

metrics.label: Finnish games industry turnover
metrics.value: about €2.85 bn (second-highest on record; down 4.9% over two years per one summary)

metrics.label: New Finnish game startups
metrics.value: 75 in the last three years; about 60 commercial games released in 2025

Global gaming M&A and private funding, Q3
metrics.value: M&A $2.4 bn over 45 deals; private funding $1.6 bn+ over 106 rounds (secondary source, per Drake Star data)

signals.title: Spinnova signs letter of intent with Outlast Technologies
signals.detail: Non-binding LOI to develop Spinnova fibre for insulation and temperature regulation. Spinnova's Woodspin demo factory is in trial runs, with larger-scale production targeted to restart during 2026, depending on trial results.

signals.title: Ubisoft proposes closing RedLynx (Trials, Helsinki)
signals.detail: Part of a wider restructuring that includes about 70 roles in Singapore and about 100 in Germany. Subject to Finnish change negotiations; reports put the affected Finnish headcount at up to about 52.

signals.title: Q3 2026 gaming deal flow concentrated in AI and dev tools
signals.detail: Reported M&A of $2.4 bn over 45 deals and $1.6 bn+ over 106 funding rounds, mostly to AI and tools. Secondary source, not verified against Drake Star.

signals.title: Metacore (Merge Mansion) confirms 159 layoffs and closes Germany and Sweden offices
signals.detail: The Helsinki mobile studio cut staff after its flagship title stagnated. The exact publication date was not confirmed; June 2026 is approximate.

signals.title: Neogames: 2026 expected to be strong, but no 2025 turnover figure
signals.detail: Neogames Finland reports 75 new startups in three years and about 60 games released in 2025. It gives no turnover or staff figures.
